intro: Is there more to mastering the arena than this? Short John Mithril, the Pirate behind the Gurubashi event, may have the answer, and you will find him in the Stranglethorn Arena.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There must be more to being a master of the arena than this! Perhaps the Pirate who runs the event at Gurubashi will know!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Arr Me Hearty! Gaining one Trinket be not enough to make ye master of the Arena! Now tis the time to truly prove your steel.
